payload.application_scope: Ledger item 9 only: the wiring, the two-clause structure and the Gauss multipliers of the L/N0/Npc affine determinant certificate. No coefficient module, marking, field, resolver, eta or source certificate is selected.

chain.head_condition: the frame element at the tame tau acts trivially on the head quotient
chain.role: At every nonzero radical line of a simple nontrivial block enrichment, the Gauss-Z residue of the source boundary map equals the unramified Gauss multiplier at the block's half-dimension.

chain.head_condition: the frame element at the tame tau moves some vector of the head quotient
chain.role: At the same lines, with the opposite head condition, the residue equals the ramified Gauss multiplier at the block's half-dimension.

payload.hash_scope: Identity of the serialized wiring, clause structure and Gauss multiplier sign and exponent at the stated discrete parameters. It is not a hash of any proof.

numerics.half_dimension: m, with block order 2^(2m) and 1 <= m

producer.scope: q = 2^f with f odd, which is narrower than the alpha and q conditions the even families use

payload.warning: AffineDeterminantCertificate is a Prop, so this display is NOT a rendering of the phase-cover proof and no formula is substituted for one. Lean has definitional proof irrelevance, so a field binding certifies that the producer proves exactly the statement the record's determinant field demands, at the record's own parameters, and NOT that the record was built from that proof term. The clause statements themselves remain in the packet's stored proofs transcript.
